findings.summary: Peloton Bike Plus (approximately 140 lbs) in upstairs bedroom not listed in inventory. Agent confirmed they would note it.
findings.quote: So first, my wife and I just realized we have this Peloton in the upstairs bedroom that we forgot to tell you about. It's the bigger one, the Bike Plus, I think it weighs around 140 pounds.

findings.summary: Destination access detail missing: service entrance off the alley at the back of the building is required; front entrance (as shown on Google Maps) is not to be used.
findings.quote: the building entrance is actually around the back, not the front like Google Maps shows. There's a service entrance off the alley. The building manager said the movers have to use that one.

findings.summary: Certificate of Insurance (COI) requirement not recorded. Building manager requires COI sent to manager@elmtowers.example.com at least 48 hours before move-in day.
findings.quote: they need a Certificate of Insurance, a COI, before move-in day. They were really firm about that. They want it sent to manager@elmtowers.example.com at least 48 hours before.

findings.summary: Freight elevator restriction not noted. Building manager requires freight elevator reservation between 10 am and 2 pm; regular elevator cannot be used by movers.
findings.quote: the freight elevator has to be reserved between 10 am and 2 pm. They won't let movers use the regular elevator at all.

findings.summary: Russian-speaking contact at destination not recorded. Mother-in-law will meet crew at destination and speaks mainly Russian; agent said they have Russian-speaking crew available.
findings.quote: my mother-in-law is going to be at the destination to let the crew in. She doesn't speak much English. She speaks Russian mainly.

findings.summary: 75-gallon saltwater fish tank (empty glass) not listed in inventory. Customer confirmed it will be drained before move-day and tank must be moved by crew.
findings.quote: We have a saltwater fish tank, it's a 75 gallon tank. We're going to drain it ourselves but the tank itself, the empty glass tank, do you guys move that?

findings.summary: Credit card payment method and 3% processing fee not recorded in CRM. Agent confirmed customer will pay by credit card on move day with 3% fee added to final total.
findings.quote: The quote came out to about three thousand four hundred. We're planning to pay by credit card on the day. Is there a fee for that or is that included? Credit card payment is fine, there's a small processing fee of three percent that gets added on the day of.
